QuestInfo.name: The Strawberry Juice Master
QuestInfo.0: So, you wanna be a fruit juice master? Well, making Strawberry Juice is the first step. There's just one little problem...
QuestInfo.1: Collect #b50 x #i03994363##t03994363##k from normal monsters to make Strawberry Juice from, and bring them to Gaga.
QuestInfo.2: You brought 50 Red Strawberries to Gaga, who gave you a #t02001541#. Tastes better than you expected!

0.0: Hey, good timing, #b#h0##k. I gotta make some Strawberry Juice right now, but monsters tore up the strawberry farm, and stole all the strawberries! For the sake of innocent fruit juices and those who enjoy them, #b#h0##k, please beat up those monsters and bring back our Red Strawberries! \r\n

Just hunt some normal monsters, and you should find some. #bHowever, monsters that are 11 levels lower or 21 levels higher than you won't have any#k.
